title: NeuronZonePayload
description: Result of dispatching the Day-at-a-Glance orchestrator to one registered specialist head. F0040 has two live heads (Renewals and Broker activity) returning content/empty/error and two inert heads (Tasks and Pipeline) returning inactive with no business data. This is assembly, not composition: a payload never reads or ranks another zone. The public shape remains replay-compatible with stored F0038/F0039 envelopes; ADR-037 hardens handler/tool/component/timeout validation around it without changing the shape.

zone_status.description: content = live head returned data; inactive = stub head (reads nothing, no CTA); empty = live head, nothing needs attention; error = head failed/timed out (slot-isolated, other zones still render).

component.description: Registered component identifier for the slot body (required when zone_status = content). Rendered via the component registry; never markup.

props.description: Validated props for the registered component (required when zone_status = content), such as Renewals needs-attention items or F0040 Broker activity events.

detail.description: Human-readable note for inactive ('not yet active'), empty ('nothing needs you in the next 90 days'), or error states.

then.description: Inactive Tasks/Pipeline payloads carry no component/props and no business data.
